system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.13.4 - Elemental Healing. Healing concussion hits (Heal Elemental I/III/V/VII/X/True), relieving minor elemental damage/irritation/stun, stopping bleeding of increasing severity (Clotting, Cut Repair, Vessel Repair minor/major, up to Clotting True), pooling elemental material into a container and bathing an elemental creature in it to heal over time, preserving and later rejoining a severed limb's blood vessels, and slow regeneration over time. Special notes from the source: these spells only work on a being that has a number of corruption points, in the caster's element, equal to twice the level of the spell being cast; and most of this list is aimed at corrupted creatures or hybrid elemental beings, since ordinary elementals cannot be stunned and do not bleed. Fidelity notes: level 15 is intentionally blank in the source (no spell printed); the Elemental Flowstop progression only ever shows a "II" (level 2) - there is no Flowstop I printed anywhere on this list, kept as-is rather than inventing it.
Target Elemental is healed of d10 Concussion hits.
Allows caster to stop bleeding of a wound on an elemental being that is bleeding up to 2 hits per round; target may not be moved or bleeding resumes.
Target Elemental is healed of one area of minor damage caused by an element. Minor damage is considered to be similar to minor frostbite or 1st degree burn (GM discretion).
Allows the caster to stop bleeding on a wound on an elemental being that is bleeding up to 2 hits per round, target may not be moved or bleeding resumes.
Target Elemental is healed of one minor irritation (e.g., headache, tooth-ache, bee-sting, hang-over, etc.)
Target Elemental is healed of 3d10 Concussion hits.
Target elemental is relieved of one round of accumulated stun. This spell goes off automatically if the caster is stunned (if the caster qualifies, i.e., has 14 corruption points in his element).
Allows caster to stop bleeding from one wound that is bleeding at 1 hit per round.
Target elemental is healed of 1 Concussion hit for every minute the caster concentrates.
Target elemental is healed of 5d10 concussion hits.

Elemental material of the caster's Main Element is pooled into a suitable container (GM's discretion, fire would burn a wood container, but any of the others would be fine). Contact with material will cause an 'A' critical to those who are unprotected or who have the "bath" spell cast on them.
Allows caster to close one open wound that is bleeding up to 5 hits per round.

Target Elemental creature can bathe in the elemental material pooled by the caster. For every minute spent in the bath it heals 5 Concussion hits or 1 hit per round of Bleeding. Bath is effective up to 1 minute per cubic foot of elemental material caster has summoned using the pool element.

Allows caster to prevent the deterioration of 1 limb (even while severed); also requires use of the same spells from the Elemental Restorations list (Limb Preservation: Muscles, Limb Preservation: Nerves, Limb Preservation: Bone.)

Allows caster to repair 1 damaged blood vessel of any size, including severed veins and arteries; recovery time: 1-10 days, depending on the size of the vessel and the severity of the damage. A major vessel is one that bleeds at 5 hits per round or more when severed.
Target Elemental is healed of 7d10 concussion hits.
As Regeneration I, except target's damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute.
Target Elemental is healed of 10d10 concussion hits.
As Clotting I, except that blood loss (i.e. hits per round) from one wound is stopped.
Allows caster to reattach severed limb; also requires use of the spells from the Elemental Preservations List (Joining: Muscles, Joining: Nerves, Joining: Bone.)
As Cut Repair I, except that it will stop bleeding and close any one wound.
Target Elemental is healed of all concussion hits.
